turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail: : Yes. A damaged item is handled differently because it requires image verification: - Within the 30-day return period: Submit a request through the Return Portal, select “Item was damaged,” and upload clear images of the damage. The team will review your submission within 2–3 business days and provide a resolution. - Past the return period or marked final sale/non-returnable: The item requires individual review. Please have your order number, item name, and clear images of the damage available.
